name: SPT-CL J0048-5244 (Webb)
blurb: SPT-CL J0048-5244, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: sptclj00485244-webb
story: A massive gathering of galaxies found in South Pole Telescope data, part of a Webb survey that traces how clusters grew across cosmic time. Webb's view helps map how dark matter spreads through the cluster.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ0048-5244 is one of the 182 massive galaxy clusters in Webb survey program 5594
The clusters were picked from Sunyaev-Zel'dovich cluster candidates (SPT, ACT and Planck) and X-ray catalogs
The survey tracks billions of years of cluster growth
Science goals: how infalling galaxies build the bright central galaxy, how dark matter is distributed and tidally stripped from sub-halos, and strong lensing
SPT clusters are found in South Pole Telescope data through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
